meta.title: Provider group fold
meta.description: Makes provider groups collapsible in DSH's built-in model menu. Each time you open the model list, only the current model's provider starts expanded. Click a heading to open or close its group. An active search expands all matching groups; with no query, use the arrow keys to move and Enter or Space to toggle a focused heading. The plugin does not replace the stock menu, model selection, reasoning controls, Agent Teams switch, or provider badges. It enhances the existing interface and may stop applying if a later DSH release changes the menu structure.
